name: Lance Rayborn
abstract_title: Color, Consciousness, and Memory: A Novel Mechanism for Reducing Pain, Stress, and Trauma through Holographic Memory Resolution®
abstract: Holographic Memory Resolution® (HMR) is an innovative, consciousness-based therapeutic method that empowers individuals to safely access and resolve trauma-imprinted memories stored within the body’s subconscious field. Integrating neuroscience, energy psychology, and guided imagery, HMR offers a nonpharmacologic, noninvasive pathway for transforming emotional and physical pain by engaging color and sensory awareness to re-establish safety in the nervous system and restore coherence across body–
